name: Rutuja Bhosale
bio:
Career Overview: Rutuja Bhosale is an accomplished Indian player with success in both singles and doubles on the ITF circuit.

Playing Style: Employs a versatile game with strong groundstrokes and a knack for doubles strategy, thriving on hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #313 (May 22, 2023)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #167 (March 6, 2023)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached Australian Open qualifying rounds in 2023.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 2 ITF singles titles and 11 ITF doubles titles.
  • Secured a gold medal in mixed doubles at the 2022 Asian Games with Rohan Bopanna.

Other Highlights:
  • A regular in ITF events, Rutuja has shown steady progress and excels in doubles partnerships with top Indian players.
